name: NameHero
tagline: LiteSpeed-powered cPanel hosting with a green, US-based data center
description: NameHero is a cPanel hosting provider built on LiteSpeed and NVMe storage, known for fast shared/reseller/VPS plans and a Kansas City data center.
about: NameHero runs cPanel-based shared hosting in four tiers: Starter Cloud, Plus Cloud, Turbo Cloud and Business Cloud, all built on LiteSpeed web servers with Redis and MariaDB included rather than the slower Apache stack many budget hosts still use. Turbo Cloud and Business Cloud also offer monthly billing, while Starter and Plus Cloud are sold on 1-, 2- and 3-year terms only.

Storage is marketed as unlimited on shared plans, but NameHero caps inode counts (file/email object limits) at around 250,000 on the two lowest tiers — worth checking if a site has huge amounts of email or small files. All shared plans include free cPanel, a free SSL certificate and one free website migration.

Introductory pricing is lowest on the 3-year term and renews significantly higher once that term ends — Starter Cloud's renewal lands around $10.95/month versus its promotional rate, and Business Cloud renews around $34.95/month. Two- and three-year signups also include a complimentary domain registration or transfer. Check NameHero's own pricing page for the exact current promotional rate before buying, since it changes with ongoing promotions.
policies: NameHero backs its Web Hosting, Reseller Hosting and VPS Hosting packages with a 30-day money-back guarantee. The refund is reduced by a non-refundable $8.95 setup fee, and NameHero limits the guarantee to one refund per customer over the lifetime of the account.

Add-on services — domain registrations, paid migrations, dedicated IPs and separately purchased LiteSpeed licenses on VPS — are excluded from the refund entirely, so only the base hosting plan cost is covered.
